main_body: Large wooden crate (left) with a plank-striped lid and a dark front face carrying a diagonal brace; a smaller crate sits to its right in the same construction.
top_band: Light tan horizontal plank stripes, rows ~1-8, lightest tone, with a lighter strip at the bottom edge
evidence: In the middle column the top is a tan band of about 8 rows with plank stripes, ending in a light front edge at row ~8. A dark eave row at ~9 follows, then a dark brown front face (rows ~10-18) and a near-black base (19-20). The top is clearly lighter than the front and is a real foreshortened surface, not a 1-2px rim. The brace is painted on the face rather than inset, but the top and front are both clearly drawn, so it reads as 3/4. The top is rather tall for the front, but acceptable.

style.evidence: The top has about 3 tan tones in plank stripes, and the front has about 2-3 browns. The front face is a large dark brown field with only a single diagonal brace line, so it is a flat fill with no grain or nail dots. The bottom edge is a neutral near-black band, while the other edges lean brown. Tiles hold only about 3-5 colours, well below the reference stall and well, which carry many per-tile highlights, grain and speckle. It reads thinner and flatter than the reference.
